developmentBacklogAdded.title: Part-time stacking conflict detector
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: For short remote shifts or brigades, calculate whether the advertised hours can coexist with another TPP/contract and estimate combined monthly income. This makes 4-hour morning opportunities useful as an income stack rather than judging them only against full-time salaries.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Future-start application window tracker
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Store future start month/season separately from publication date and surface the application lead window before seasonal hiring closes. This prevents useful October-January roles discovered in September from being forgotten or ranked as merely not-immediate.
